title: Filtered colimits of strictly henselian local rings along local maps
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty small directed poset and $(R_i,\varphi_{ij})_{i\leq j}$ a direct system of commutative local rings, with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_i$. Assume every $R_i$ is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and every transition homomorphism is local, meaning $\varphi_{ij}^{-1}(\mathfrak m_j)=\mathfrak m_i$. Let $R=\varinjlim_iR_i$ be the colimit in commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $R$ is a strictly henselian local ring. Neither injectivity nor surjectivity of the transition maps is assumed.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, strictly henselian case; statement and proof.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-local-colimit-residue-field] to the given small nonempty directed system. Its hypothesis on inverse images of maximal ideals is exactly the assumed locality. Thus $R$ is local with maximal ideal $M=\bigcup_i\alpha_i(\mathfrak m_i)$, every $\alpha_i$ is local, and $\kappa=R/M$ with $\rho_i([x])=[\alpha_i(x)]$ is the ring colimit of the fields $\kappa_i=R_i/\mathfrak m_i$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, strictly henselian case; assembly of the corresponding separated argument.

proof.text: Each $\kappa_i$ is separably closed by the strict henselianity assumption and [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Apply [lem-sfb-separably-closed-field-colimit] to the residue-field colimit of step 1. Its index is still small, nonempty and directed, and all residue transitions are field maps. Hence $\kappa$ is separably closed.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, strictly henselian case; assembly of the corresponding separated argument.

proof.text: Each $R_i$ is henselian by [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Given monic $f\in R[T]$ and $a_0\in\kappa$ with $\overline f(a_0)=0$ and $\overline{f'}(a_0)\ne0$, step 1 supplies the local colimit legs and residue-colimit cocone required by [lem-sfb-henselian-colimit-stage-root]. That statement gives a stage $i$, a monic $f_i$ of the same degree mapping to $f$, a residue element $a_{0,i}$ mapping to $a_0$, and $a_i\in R_i$ with $f_i(a_i)=0$ and $[a_i]=a_{0,i}$. Set $a=\alpha_i(a_i)$. Applying $\alpha_i$ to the finite evaluation sum gives $f(a)=\alpha_i(f_i(a_i))=0$; the residue formula from step 1 gives $[a]=\rho_i([a_i])=\rho_i(a_{0,i})=a_0$.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, strictly henselian case; assembly of the corresponding separated argument.

proof.text: Step 3 is the monic simple-root lifting condition for the local ring $R$. Apply implication (ii)$\Rightarrow$(i) of [lem-weil-pbc-henselian-local-root-lifting] to conclude that $R$ is henselian in the idempotent-lifting convention. With the separably closed residue field of step 2, [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] makes $R$ strictly henselian.

source.place: Tag 04GI, lemma-colimit-henselian, strictly henselian case; assembly of the corresponding separated argument.
